reviews.comment: Very good prof, extremely knowledgeable. This class really made me think.

Her class isn't hard; there is LOTS reading, weekly quizzes, and open-note exams. But she is a hard grader and provides absolutely zero feedback on anything, and is also not the most pleasant and seldom responds to emails. I made an A so I can't complain too much, but if you value a nice learning environment I would take another professor.
She is an excellent professor. She is so knowledgeable about philosophy, and her class really makes you think.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: She cares a lot about her students and the material, and she explains everything extremely clearly. I learned a lot in this class.

I liked her discussion based lectures and generally learned a lot. She was gone a lot though and had her TA sub for her, GREAT TA. I didn't like the grading though and if you don't do the readings you will be pretty lost.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Pretty boring lectures and attendance every single class. LOTS of reading but everyone stops actually doing it by like the second week. No computers allowed so you can't do other work. Only two tests (multiple choice and essay) but she gave us all the questions before the exam so pretty easy if you make outlines.

Just pick someone else. Graded on only a few assignments, two of which equate to 50% of the grade (mid-term & final essay). Attendance is mandatory for this incredibly boring class, & the class is essentially just a long discussion of a bunch of nothing. Take it literally anywhere else if you really need this credit. She was not it. TA good though

reviews.comment: Great class and professor! Take her!
Dr. Islekel is a great professor. I learned so much in this class!

Hours of reading every week for an elective class. Lectures are surface level discussion and participation graded but there isnt anything to contribute. She isnt good at explaining things, answering questions,  responding to emails, or attending her own office hours. and you don't have enough time for the exam worth 1/4 your grade. take anyone else

Just don't. There's better options for this class and all of them will probably be more enjoyable and easy as hers. Classes consist of a boring and long lecture/discussion about the different philosophers and majority of your grade comes from the last few weeks of class (35% essay final and 15% group presentation grade). Attendance is mandatory.

reviews.comment: The material was very difficult but the discussion made everything so much more clear and accessible. I honestly looked forward to going to every single class. She really is doing an amazing job.

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, amazing class. Take her class!

Honestly I loved going to every single class, this was my favorite class this semester. She is amazing at making difficult ideas very easy to grasp and wants to hear what you think. She is not an easy grader, but if you follow all the instructions, you'll do fine. Take her class.
